workflow: A caller supplies a negative count where the operation requires a nonnegative value.
The interface forwards the unchecked value to a lower-level routine.
The routine uses the invalid count in range or pointer calculations and accesses records outside valid storage.
The process crashes instead of returning a recoverable argument-range error.
summary: Unchecked negative count causes downstream out-of-bounds access
decision_reason: The bug shares the core workflow of an invalid numeric argument being forwarded without validation to a lower-level routine that treats it as valid and dereferences invalid memory, although the specific argument and native operation differ.
